question:
Which of the following about the 73rd Inter Services Water Polo Championship 2024-25 is/are correct?

1.) Hosted by Eastern Naval Command at Dolphin Hill Pool, Visakhapatnam.

2.) Navy defeated Army to win the title.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both 1 and 2 are correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **73rd Inter Services Water Polo Championship 2024-25** was hosted by the Eastern Naval Command at Dolphin Hill Pool, Visakhapatnam.
 
• Visakhapatnam serves as a major base for the Indian Navy and is home to the Eastern Naval Command, making it a frequent venue for inter-services events.
 
• In the championship, **the Navy defeated the Army** in a closely contested match to secure the title.
 
• The Navy's victory highlights its strong water polo team and its dominance in aquatic sports among the Indian defense forces.
 
• Such inter-services championships foster camaraderie and competitive spirit among the armed forces while promoting physical fitness and discipline.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dolphin Hill Pool, Visakhapatnam**

 
 
• Dolphin Hill is a prominent location within the Eastern Naval Command, known for its state-of-the-art facilities for aquatic sports and training.
 
• The pool is often used for professional-level competitions and training sessions for naval personnel.
 
• It is equipped with advanced facilities to host large-scale aquatic events, making it an ideal venue for the championship.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Inter Services Championships**
 
 
• Inter-services championships are organized among the Army, Navy, and Air Force to encourage sportsmanship and physical excellence.
 
• They provide an opportunity for armed forces personnel to showcase their talents and promote team spirit.
 
• Such events also help maintain high physical fitness standards and discipline within the defense forces.
 
 
 
• **Water Polo as a Competitive Sport**
 
 
• Water polo is a team aquatic sport that requires swimming proficiency, endurance, and strategic gameplay.
 
• It is often played in defense forces to enhance physical fitness and teamwork among personnel.
 
• India’s defense forces have a long tradition of excelling in aquatic sports, with many athletes representing the country in national and international events.
 
 
 
• **Eastern Naval Command**
 
 
• The Eastern Naval Command is one of the three major commands of the Indian Navy, headquartered in Visakhapatnam.
 
• It oversees naval operations along India's eastern coastline and is crucial for maritime security.
 
• The command frequently organizes inter-services and intra-navy events to boost morale and encourage physical fitness among its personnel.
